articles.title: Canada's First Spacewalk in Seven Years Will Boost Station Power
articles.summary: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk makes his first spacewalk on October 29, joining NASA's Anil Menon to install new roll-out solar arrays that will boost the station's power by about 30 percent.

articles.title: The Secret Glow of the Fire Salamander
articles.summary: Fire salamanders secretly glow green and cyan under ultraviolet light, thanks to their skin glands; scientists are still working out what the glow is for.

articles.title: The Grave That Was Double-Guarded Against the Undead
articles.summary: A 17th-century Polish grave fitted with both a sickle and a padlock is the first known to combine two anti-vampire precautions, and its occupant seems to have been a wealthy local young woman.
